_comment: Pass 'sec-b': secondary people — the real, named people who appear in the p3c01-p3c24 history stories and teaching bodies but are NOT the chapter's card subject (card subjects live in src/assets/licences.json and are another agent's). Every licence below was read off the file's own Commons description page via the API's extmetadata plus the raw wikitext licence template, never off an article that uses the file. Identity was confirmed against the description, the file's global usage and the Wikidata item before download. Files are downscaled to 480px on the long edge, EXIF stripped, JPEG q82 progressive, never cropped. Rows appear here only for files this pass created; files already written by the parallel p0/p1/p2 secondary pass are recorded in `triage` under `already_present` with their path and carry their row in that pass's manifest, not this one. Retrieved 2026-08-22.
